chapters.title: Python in Power Platform done wrong
Azure Functions: Python without training wheels

takeaways: Use the Copilot Studio code interpreter for immediate, local and disposable tasks such as quick file conversions and one-off analyses.
Move recurring, business-critical or high-volume Python workloads to Azure Functions with versioning, managed identities and Application Insights monitoring.
Prototype in the code interpreter sandbox, then promote stable logic to Azure Functions with CI/CD to satisfy both innovation and governance.
hook: Python now runs natively in Power Platform through the Copilot Studio code interpreter, and teams are misusing it in both directions. This episode shows makers, analysts and architects where the sandbox ends and Azure Functions begins. You get a clear decision framework plus a prototype-to-production pattern that keeps admins and auditors happy.
